sections.text:
-Target: all allies. Increases max HP by 60% for 120 seconds.
Max HP increasing effect boosted by 10% for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies 30% concentration for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical and magic damage taken by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies a Greater Counter Heal that restores 10% HP when attacked for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Increases Aggro for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Grace for 120 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
Reduces Dark Unison Attack and Great Spirit Unison Attack damage by 40% when equipped in the main slot.
